final: SELECT f.orderslink, o.ordertune, AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebate, AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / f.feerate) as avg_relative_gap, AVG(f.rebtotal) - (SELECT AVG(f2.rebtotal) FROM fees f2 INNER JOIN orders o2 ON f2.orderslink = o2.recordvault) as margin_above_avg FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune HAVING AVG(f.rebtotal) > (SELECT AVG(f2.rebtotal) FROM fees f2 INNER JOIN orders o2 ON f2.orderslink = o2.recordvault) ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
